Context: 3. Modes of Procurement

- (b)
- Global Tender Enquiry (GTE)  
Open Tender Enquiry is the default mode of procurement and gives the best value for money but the procedure is relatively complex and prolonged. The systemic cost of this procedure may be high enough to be unviable for smaller value procurements. Procurements exceeding t 25 lakhs may be done through OTE. - Para. 4.2, Manual for Procurement of Goods.
